title: Faithful reduction reflects pullback tensor comparison naturality
statement: Let C,D,S,T be categories, Q:C→S and R:D→T functors, with R faithful. Let F:C→D, H:S→T, and bifunctors U,V,J,I on the corresponding categories. Suppose natural isomorphisms identify UQ with (Q×Q)J, VR with (R×R)I, FR with QH, and JH with (H×H)I. A componentwise isomorphism ν:F(U(M,N))≅V(FM,FN) satisfying the resulting component reduction equation is natural in both inputs.

source.place: Tag 07A4 and the recorded parent coefficient-coherence argument

proof.text: Compose the specified natural isomorphisms to obtain p from reduced V(F-,F-) to I(HQ-,HQ-) and q from reduced FU to that same functor. The component equation is R(ν) p = q. For a pair of morphisms, postcompose the desired reduced naturality square by p at the target. Naturality of p and q proves equality. Cancel p, whose components are isomorphisms, and use faithfulness of R.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4; elaboration and factoring of the parent normalization argument

lean.statement:
theorem reducedComparison_natural
    {C D S T : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D] [Category* S] [Category* T]
    (Q : C ⥤ S) (R : D ⥤ T) [R.Faithful]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (H : S ⥤ T) (U : C × C ⥤ C) (V : D × D ⥤ D)
    (J : S × S ⥤ S) (I : T × T ⥤ T)
    (a : U ⋙ Q ≅ (Q.prod Q) ⋙ J) (b : V ⋙ R ≅ (R.prod R) ⋙ I)
    (c : F ⋙ R ≅ Q ⋙ H) (μ : J ⋙ H ≅ (H.prod H) ⋙ I)
    (ν : ∀ M N, F.obj (U.obj (M, N)) ≅ V.obj (F.obj M, F.obj N))
    (hc : ∀ M N, R.map (ν M N).hom ≫ b.hom.app (F.obj M, F.obj N) ≫
        I.map (Prod.mkHom (c.hom.app M) (c.hom.app N)) =
      c.hom.app (U.obj (M, N)) ≫ H.map (a.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
        μ.hom.app (Q.obj M, Q.obj N))
    {M M' N N' : C} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    F.map (U.map (Prod.mkHom f g)) ≫ (ν M' N').hom =
      (ν M N).hom ≫ V.map (Prod.mkHom (F.map f) (F.map g))
